verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an Enrichment API for incomes, recurring expenses, risk insights and employment metrics, plus plain transaction history retrieval. Nothing documents enriching raw transactions with cleaned merchant names, categories or logos. That adjacent enrichment product does not establish the capability, so the story is undelivered on this evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, raw bank transactions come back enriched — cleaned merchant names, categories, and logos — documented as a capability of the platform, not left as an exercise for me
